commitResults.messageTitle: Organize application classes into Java packages
commitResults.messageBody: Group task domain classes under loki.model, parsing under loki.parser, persistence under loki.storage, and console interaction under loki.ui. Keep Loki as the loki package entry point, isolate custom exceptions under loki.exception, and place the text utility under loki.util. Update the UI test plan to compile the package paths and launch loki.Loki while preserving unrelated user changes.

commitResults.messageBody:
The Java sources contain inconsistent names, imports, comments, and control-flow formatting.

Apply consistent Java naming, layout, fall-through comments, American English, and public JavaDoc across the application so the code follows one readable standard.

commitResults.messageTitle: Agent guidance: Add Java coding standard
commitResults.messageBody:
Java edits need a project-specific interpretation of the SE-EDU conventions.

Add the seedu-java-coding-standard skill and require it from AGENTS.md so future Java changes use consistent naming, layout, and JavaDoc rules.

Future commits and branches need consistent project conventions for readable history.

Add the seedu-git-standard skill and require it from AGENTS.md so commit messages explain what and why, and branch names remain meaningful and consistent.

commitResults.messageTitle: Set up Checkstyle and fix violations
Show farewell message before closing window
Add assertions to document internal assumptions
Replace parser offsets with named markers
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline and event parsing hard-code offsets separately from the marker
strings. A reader has to infer why the offsets are 4 or 6, and changing a
marker can leave the substring boundaries inconsistent.

Define named markers and derive offsets from their lengths. This follows
the code-quality guideline to avoid magic numbers while preserving command
syntax and case-insensitive matching. Add regression tests for mixed-case
markers, missing fields, reversed markers, and invalid dates.

Validation: Java 25 JUnit tests and Checkstyle pass. The console plan stops
at UI-002 because tasks persist between cases, as reproduced before this
change. No user-visible behavior is changed.

Three event constructors repeat the same endpoint checks and assignments.
Maintaining those copies separately risks accepting different intervals
when a validation rule changes.

Delegate the default and boolean constructors to the numeric-status
constructor so every overload uses one validation path. This follows the
guideline to minimize code duplication and retains validation of invalid
numeric statuses. Add tests for each overload, missing endpoints, reversed
and zero-duration intervals, and stored completion state.

Validation: Java 25 JUnit tests and Checkstyle pass. The console plan stops
at the same baseline UI-002 persistence issue. No user-visible behavior is
changed.

commitResults.messageTitle: Split storage parsing by task type
commitResults.messageBody:
The record parser mixes shared-field validation, task-type dispatch, and
nested date and interval parsing in one long method. Readers must follow
all three task formats to understand the overall loading flow.

Extract a parser for each task type and keep the main method focused on
shared validation and dispatch. This follows the guidelines to avoid long
methods and use a single level of abstraction. Keep field-count checks,
validation order, storage format, and error details unchanged.

Add public-API regression tests for round trips, missing files, all record
types, invalid field counts, statuses, dates, and event intervals.

Validation: all 49 Java 25 JUnit tests and Checkstyle checks pass. The
console plan stops at UI-002 due to the pre-existing shared task file
between test cases; baseline and post-change transcripts are retained.

commitResults.messageTitle: Format task lists with a stream pipeline
commitResults.messageBody:
The list response uses a mutable counter and StringBuilder to turn ordered
tasks into numbered display lines. This is a direct transformation and
joining operation that fits a stream pipeline.

Use IntStream to enumerate task positions, map each position to its display
line, and join the lines with the platform separator. Keep one-based
numbering, encounter order, trimming, and the empty-list response intact.
Add regression tests for mixed task types, duplicates, completion status,
repeat listing, empty lists, and renumbering after deletion.

Validation: all 52 JUnit tests and both Checkstyle checks pass on Java 25.
The console plan stops at the existing UI-002 task-persistence issue.
JavaFX smoke testing was not performed.
